newsitem.title: UK: Imperial Tobacco up as Warburg repeats buy.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Tobacco up as Warburg repeats buy.

text.p: Shares in Imperial Tobacco advanced on Wednesday as brokerage SBC Warburg reiterated a buy recommendation, dealers said.
By 1139 GMT, the shares were up 13p to 366p on trading volume of more than 5.2 million shares, placing them among the most actively traded shares in London.
Dealers said SBC Warburg also repeated its cautious stance toward B.A.T Industries, which may have inspired switching. B.A.T shares were off 1p to 416p.
Shares in Imperial have been falling during the past month and SBC Warburg reiterated its view that the shares look cheap.
